reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM.

For anything on the Larchmont rollout, I told her to call Soren Tolland. She asked me on Oct 14 to remember him as her escalation contact there. That note came from her own DM, so it went back only to her.

For other problems, I pointed her to Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations, who is the main contact on file for Quarrendon Freight Lines. Thea joined the call during the Superior terminal Sev 1 in November 2025. For engineering help on our side, I suggested #inc-qfl-sev1, where Ilse and Samir Patel from on-call handled that incident. Dana is a member of that channel.

I couldn't find a phone number for Soren or Thea in anything Dana can see, and I said so in the reply.
